classifications.finding: The compiled gate module is generated-adapted/Funs.lean, not generated-original/Funs.lean (the only path-named candidate PRV could see). The adapted file replaces three Aeneas iterator/zip externals by the hand-written P6ToBytes.StdModel.MutableIterator, zipNext and MutableIterator.zip.trait_default. PCO_L007 (self-copy of the adapted text, all 8 declarations rfl against the gate constants) shows the gate equals the adapted text; PCO_L008 shows the fresh frozen emission matches only to_limbs (1 of 4 reached definitions) and three impl_defs of the fresh text do not even elaborate against the gate's FunsExternal.
classifications.classification: partition error of the PRV method (candidate selection by path+imports), not a protocol or source change. Module moved a -> c1 in PCO_PARTITION.json (field pilot_correction); rows unchanged because all 18 rows already relied on group c. PCO_shadow.py lists 14 modules with the same ambiguity (compiled_source_ambiguous); the equality statements are against compiled constants so they stay valid, but the PRV group of those 14 modules is provisional.
classifications.action: P2/P5 must decide the compiled text per ambiguous module by the self-copy control (as PCO_L007) or by regenerating from the gate; do not trust path+imports alone.

classifications.case: text-identical definition whose callee is not equal (NFG CM31.neg / QM31.neg)
classifications.finding: PRV coverage IDENTICAL is per definition text. CM31.neg calls M31.neg, whose gate body uses checked U32 subtraction while the frozen emission uses wrapping_sub; the equality of CM31.neg is blocked by it.
classifications.classification: calibration: IDENTICAL is an upper bound for rfl; the generator records blocked-by-callee as the class of the blocking callee (semantic here).
classifications.action: none for P0; P3 handles the domain-restricted M31.neg equality (canonical self <= P).

classifications.case: fresh Types vs gate Types and external boundaries
classifications.finding: The generator compiles the fresh Funs against the gate's Types by `open <gate namespace>` and Lean's name-resolution priority (names declared in the fresh namespace win; undeclared names fall through to the opened gate namespace). This is only sound if (a) the fresh Types are text-identical after normalization (checked per type; PCO_gen_equalities.py report types_identity), (b) no fresh Funs name leaks to a gate Funs constant (report names_resolved_to_gate_funs; empty in all three pilots except the external solana_pubkey.Pubkey in AdapterRwTypes), and (c) any fresh declaration that fails to elaborate is dropped with all its dependents (otherwise its name would leak to the gate constant and make rfl trivially true). Rules (b)/(c) are implemented; (a) uses the normalization: comments dropped, whitespace collapsed, Aeneas registration attributes (rust_type, rust_trait*, rust_fun, rust_loop*, discriminant, import_union_discriminant) ignored, other attributes (reducible, irreducible, global_simps) kept.
classifications.classification: mechanism choice under brief item 3(a); it does not change any claim. Registration attributes are stripped from the fresh copy because they are keyed by Rust path and would be registered twice.
classifications.action: P2 reviews report.names_resolved_to_gate_funs and external_funs for every module; an external boundary resolved to the gate constant is an inherited assumption, not an equality proved here.

classifications.finding: Lean theorems are generated for def/abbrev types whose body names no structure of the same file (rfl) and for parameterless structures whose fields are closed or a direct simple fresh type (generated Equiv, proofs `cases; rfl`). Other types (inductives, structures with nested containers of fresh types, trait-parameterised structures) get a Python text-identity check only and are listed as text_identical_only; they have no Lean equality in P0.
classifications.classification: weakest sufficient interface for P0: because the fresh Funs are compiled against the gate Types, type isomorphisms are needed only where the Types differ; the Equiv generator is an evidence bonus, not a dependency of the Funs lane. text_identical_only is NOT a Lean-proved fact and is reported separately.
classifications.action: P2 decides whether to extend the Equiv generator to Array/Option/Slice fields or accept text identity for these types.

classifications.finding: Used 13 of 15 scopes: 4 extraction (E001-E004, cap 4) and 9 Lean (L001-L009). The pilot cap of 6 Lean scopes was reached by L006; L007 (self-copy control for the loop question), L008 and L009 (per-file compile of the two deliverables that had only been compiled inside a bundle) were taken from the remaining 5. L001 and L004 were wasted by generator defects fixed before the next scope (L001 unnamed trace markers: stage cannot be recovered from the Lean log because info messages carry no position; L004 `/- -/` nesting of the dropped-block comment). No scope was killed by memory or timeout, no cap or timeout was raised, no scope was rerun unchanged (every rerun followed a recorded generator change).
classifications.classification: within the 15-scope total; the sub-split is exceeded by 3 and recorded here instead of silently absorbed.
classifications.action: 2 scopes remain for a re-pilot if the lead wants one.
